scope: Behavior tests of the customization adapter with a faithful interface mock; this is not a GPU, gameplay or physics-solver verification.

results.name: not-ready and unknown controls report unsupported without mutation
construction is side-effect free and explicit initialization uses the supplied profile
partial patches leave unrelated runtime settings intact
rider loads finish before first-person and gear application
invalid numbers, choices and booleans are rejected without false success
engine rejection and missing hooks are visible
readback catches silent failures and rider/physics gear disagreement
snapshots read current engine state rather than a requested profile
queued rider changes are serialized and no-op profiles do not reload models
one failed change does not discard independent controls or later requests
reset restores engine defaults rather than the saved initialization profile
